svg.text: Frame: X along the arm from the pivot, Z outboard. The part is symmetric about its long axis: one print serves left and right.
Ø8.4 clearance for the horn boss;
four M2 on the Ø16 horn PCD → pitch servo horn
XL430 drops in horn-up; four M2 through the walls
servo lead exits here toward the pivot
tightens the boss onto the axle
Inboard face (Z = 0) → print this face down
